$comment: Sky backdrops for the View menu. The engine ENUMERATES this at build time (scene.ts import.meta.glob over *.jpg next to it) — adding a backdrop = drop a 2:1 equirectangular panorama here + one entry below; no code changes. Keep files small (≤ ~400 KB): the app is a static Pages bundle. 'default' = the backdrop a fresh profile starts on (we: 'make sky backdrop default'); an explicit 'none' or a stored valid pick always wins over it.
